title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387944011068 from four additional rational returns
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387944011068** for the complete P104 multiplier. The directed rational crossing is **[0.00387944011076, 0.00387944011077]**. The finite lower exceeds the preceding #7786 word’s directed upper of **0.00387827242164** by **0.00000116768904**. It exceeds #7781’s directed upper of **0.00386981257853** by **0.00000962753215**. Both comparisons use the same 48-call rational caller, 36-call binary service and outer premises. I request maintainer review of this conditional gain for frontier eligibility. [Four-return proof and reproduction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/README.md) · [Previous #7786 checkpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/787cdddaa7f32b05c44452b8c52a376b600b5348) · [Original #7781 supplier](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7781)

The enrolled target is **0.00387981257853**. At that point the four returns save **1.190025625558563584734867–1.190025625558563584734868** signed units over the preceding submission. The remaining deficit is **0.379442169416081001142560–0.379442169416081001142561** signed units, or **0.00000037246785** in κ. Canonical main selects #7000 at **0.00363005817**. [Complete signed invoice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/application.json) · [Selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json)

## Construction and independent review

The four returns split paid slots 34003, 99044, 94318 and 95914 on charts 288, 117, 304 and 288. They retire old helper addresses 283, 332, 942 and 403. The two chart-288 returns use different funded transfers and retain independent data. Each step explicitly debits its surrendered paid and productive grades, recalibrates later reads on the actual preceding word, and restores the caller’s observations. The complete bill has **283,248 paid positions and 52,512 productive targets**. [Ordered journal](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/BIRTHS.json) · [Reconstruction and four paid omission witnesses](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/construction.json)

Independent replay checks **1,661,521 coefficients in each orientation**, all 400 main chart positions, four fresh arbitrary identities, 50 changed physical chart adapters, 16 literal omissions and 94,449 addressed overwrites. The widened rational numerators use a bounded ordinary scalar program with 24-bit primitive constants, four guarded streams and W+26 padding. Its full ordinary price includes the additional divisions, multiplications, ripple additions and scratch clears. All three rational words were repriced under the same compiler and embedded on a common exact operational grid. The independent binary certificate admits **0.0038799074072**. The application retains the upstream premises for the native operator, owned erasure, finite compiler, precision tape and analytic recovery. [Independent physical check](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/operator.json) · [Expanded ordinary audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/audit.json) · [Shared grid](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/evidence/common-grid.json)

The mathematical word is `c447b6d5ba956fbe40834fe3c1bc69af2f225736f1b97ecd84b57bab9dd283cb`. Its layout is `f7de788c4a559282d35a9fce42f841a0e8de5a4015db871e718f9245569b0aa7`. The three-return intermediate is separately committed and independently qualified at **0.00387937849702**. [Three-return checkpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/a7de798e74315c12407f25debeff04fdc5898c4f)

## Reproduction and credit

Use Python 3.12 from the repository root. After preparing the cache, use `construction`, `operator`, `application`, `comparators`, `audit`, and the three `charts-N` shards as separate parts. The eight earlier jobs also reproduce the predecessor and its binary supplier.

```sh
python3 -IB research/p104-iterated-returns/prepare_sources.py /tmp/p104-sources --fetch
python3 -IB research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation/replay.py --cache /tmp/p104-sources --part audit --out /tmp/p104-audit
```

Clear1nsight prepared the continued construction with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate computational reviews. The original paid splits and P104 caller follow Ali Romman’s #7776. The paid projection, comparator, binary and physical work follows #7774, #7781 and the predecessors credited in the package.
